unit/symbol-only strings belong here -- anything else should be translated.

code references is dead weight and the test fails on it.
Both lists may contain stale entries; the test only fails on keys missing from them.
source_guard: keyed "<path>::<snippet>". Only for a snippet that really is a protocol token; compare a bool/enum instead of the message whenever you can.
